purpose: Freeze the ARM64 Linux build substrate used for all reference compiler work. Every field is either a resolved immutable value or an explicit resolution policy whose output must be recorded before first use.

containerRuntime.note: This is the Day-1 execution substrate. It is installed, receipt-verified, and its bootstrap contract has a full green evidence run.

buildImage.resolutionPolicy: Resolve the platform-specific manifest digest at seal time from the registry, record it here as manifestDigest, and never reference the image by tag again.

aptSnapshot.policy: Pin snapshot.debian.org to the timestamp recorded at seal time; record the full installed package manifest (name, version, sha256) after provisioning.

rust.recordedArtifact: resolved rustc binary sha256, not the rustup proxy
rust.rationale: 1.97.1 fixes an LLVM miscompilation present since at least 1.87; the preinstalled 1.94.0 is therefore not acceptable merely because it exists.
